name: 98. Bedrock service tier capability gating (bedrock-service-tier-gating)
description: Bedrock supports non-Standard service tiers only for an explicit subset of models. Sending service_tier=priority to a Standard-only model such as GPT-5.6 Luna previously reached Converse as serviceTier.type=priority and failed with HTTP 400 ("The provided service tier is not supported for this model."). The first two cases pin both native request builders: Responses and Chat Completions must omit unsupported priority from the Bedrock Runtime request so AWS selects Standard. The third case prevents an over-broad fix by requiring Bedrock Mantle to retain priority for Grok 4.6, whose model capability row advertises Priority/Flex support. Run this folder with compat off so the provider serializers, rather than compat parameter dropping, own the assertions.
